title: Two Rooks, Neither Helps
setup: Black's rooks stand on c8 and d5 and its bishop on h4 is eyeing your position, while your own pieces are scattered.
hint: The obvious capture wins a rook. Look instead for the capture that leaves Black with only one legal answer.
explanation:
## The Idea

Taking on d5 wins a rook and the game goes on. {{Qxc8+}} wins the other one and ends it: {{Bd8}} is the only block, and {{Qxd8#}} follows. Choose the capture that gives check, not the one that gives more.
